//: Blindfold for skin authoring. Launch with:  claude --settings .claude/skin-blind.settings.json
//2: Blocks every rendering of the CURRENT visual language while leaving the behaviour contract, the skin API, the shared chassis and the test fixtures readable. See .claude/commands/build-skin.md.
//3: The Bash text-tool denials below exist because Read/Grep denials alone do not stop `grep -A 30 <pattern> Theme.swift` from reconstructing a blocked file. They are broad on purpose. build-skin.md reproduces every chassis declaration the agent needs, with types, so nothing legitimate requires reading a blocked path.
//4: screencapture is deliberately NOT denied: build-skin.md requires the agent to screenshot every state of its own skin, and capture-states.sh cannot run without it. The rule that keeps that honest is behavioural, not enforced — capture only the window id returned by test-cases/capture-dialog.swift, and never run a dialog without DIALOG_SKIN set to the new skin's id.
